paired_accuracy.interpretation: Descriptive paired non-inferiority evidence only; no significance adoption gate.

latency.comparison: Contemporaneous case-paired timings; not an isolated endpoint causal effect.

interpretation.labels: AI-labelled, not human-reviewed; descriptive sample evidence, not deployment safety proof.
interpretation.baseline: C safety and quality are reported, not adoption requirements; both arms require <=1% operational failures.
interpretation.exact_quality: At least 148/150 each repeat: the owner-approved absolute two-error allowance from v1, not scaled-ceiling 407/409.
interpretation.recall_quality: At least ceil(non_in_scope_n*29/30) each repeat, giving 58/60 on the frozen fresh set.
interpretation.bootstrap: 10000 case-cluster resamples, seed 20261103, percentile 95%; all repeats remain together.
interpretation.deployment: No deployment is performed. No significance or McNemar adoption gate.
